description: Manage your local model machine over MCP: state, model pull/remove, service switch, LoRA training
name: io.github.setheerwagen/mcp-modelmanager

environmentVariables.description: Address of the model machine (127.0.0.1, LAN IP or tunnel/VPN address)
environmentVariables.name: MM_VM_HOST

environmentVariables.description: SSH user on the model machine
environmentVariables.name: MM_VM_USER

environmentVariables.description: Root directory on the machine holding all model, adapter and cache data
environmentVariables.name: MM_CONTAINER_ROOT

environmentVariables.description: Highest tool tier exposed: read, control or destructive
environmentVariables.name: MM_MAX_TIER

environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of exact tool names, applied on top of MM_MAX_TIER; a typo aborts startup. Empty means everything within MM_MAX_TIER
environmentVariables.name: MM_ENABLED_OPERATIONS

environmentVariables.description: Optional: address of a second machine sharing the GPU, used to interpret unreachability. Leave empty if there is only one machine
environmentVariables.name: MM_VM2_HOST

title: Model Manager
